page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin (Hagg., Malach., Jerem./Gr. references) and a few small marginal marks on the right edge.

main_text.p: ultima ei manus, duce Zorobabele, Iosua Iosedec, Haggæus et Zacharia Prophetis, ad quorum bitem Dei de non inhibenda impositurum templi urbis, & Politiæ reflaurationem Iubi ...

[illegible, ~40 letters]. Inde LXXII Danielis leptimanæ complentur dicentur. Apud ETHNICOS Sanctii templa Iovis nomina Lysandria vocare civiterunt, & renovatur civitates aras ipsi tanquam Deo ob victoriam ...

[illegible, ~60 letters] honorem Iaciendi preceperunt. Syracusani pro victoria Nicia in festum ... men Athenarum celebratur ... [illegible, ~30 letters]. Athenienses ἐπυσία ... fidum omnibus Diis dicatum ... brabant inquit ... & vota pro civitate & ... Θυσία Sacrifici ... Haec eam, in templo Erechtei, cum parakit, ex decreto Atheniensis, quod Cynolarge in templo Hercules ... erat plurimum ex nelle, serpentis ... ara, offerebant. His adde Ἑρμαῖα quae in honorem Mercurii, in palaestris pecuniae proiiciebant ... nemi celebrabantur, adulterorum nomen ... Iunii ingredi ... & Cyllenes ... specie Deum ... Pericles ... condidum eis Atheniis ... a Callistrate ... Ictino in Cecropia ... Minerva ... Athenarum ... Mithridati ... ... Deo ...
[illegible, ~80 letters] numero natorum &c. Apud MACEDONAS Mulierum honori ...

page.notes: Much of the page is faded and the text is damaged, especially in the middle and lower sections; many lines are illegible. Left-margin notes "Hagg. c. 2.", "Malach. 1.", "Jerem. Grac." are only partly legible. Greek words in the lower half are only approximated.
